# FarmaKit

> Browser tool for Spanish pharmacies. It fills in the header of the coupon sheets for electronic
> prescriptions (fulls de cupons precinte / hojas de cupones precinto) as a PDF the user prints on
> top of the official sheets, and it has barcode-scanner setup guides for Farmatic. Free, open
> source, no backend: the pharmacy's data never leaves the browser.

- Spanish: https://nuncaeslupus.github.io/farma-kit/
- Catalan: https://nuncaeslupus.github.io/farma-kit/ca/
- Basque: https://nuncaeslupus.github.io/farma-kit/eu/
- Galician: https://nuncaeslupus.github.io/farma-kit/gl/

The page is for a person and has no API, so do not try to drive it or send it data.

## Coupon-sheet headers

The user picks their colegio de farmacéuticos, fills in the pharmacy's data and prints the PDF
onto the official sheets from the wholesaler; FarmaKit prints only the pharmacy's data, never the
sheet. Templates exist for the Catalan colegios (Barcelona, Girona, Lleida, Tarragona). Other
colegios are listed but cannot be selected yet; the page offers to request one.

## Barcode scanners for Farmatic

Many scanners do not send the GS separator Farmatic needs between the fields of a medicine's
DataMatrix code, so lot, expiry and serial number are rejected or mixed up. Each scanner page
gives the configuration codes to scan, in order, and a final check:

- [All scanners](https://nuncaeslupus.github.io/farma-kit/lectores/)
- [Honeywell Voyager 1472g](https://nuncaeslupus.github.io/farma-kit/lectores/honeywell-voyager-1472g/)
- [Tera D5100](https://nuncaeslupus.github.io/farma-kit/lectores/tera-d5100/)
